grammar.summary: 本课学习购物清单场景中的 have got 与数量表达。

points.title: have got 表拥有
points.explanation: 英式口语中 have got = have：I've got a list. 否定 haven't got，疑问 Have you got...?

examples.en: I hope that you've got some money.

points.title: hope 宾语从句（初步接触）
points.explanation: hope 后接完整句子表愿望：I hope (that) you've got some money. that 可省略。

examples.en: What do we need? We need a lot of things.
examples.cn: 我们需要什么？我们需要很多东西。
